Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You beckon through a breath of grave-cold mist. A dead shape assembles, bearing the marks of a life it only resembles.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint.
Type
Magic / Summoning

Choose one Undead entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 3 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
